## What it does

The agent is much more careful when it deals with astronomical data. Its answers are more precise, and often come with citations.

## SKILL.md

[Download SKILL.md](SKILL.md){download="SKILL.md"} and put it in a folder `astro-research` in your agent's skills directory.

```{.markdown include="SKILL.md"}
```

## How to check the result

**Tested on:** Ask for a definition, for instance "spectral index", and check whether references are given.

With the skill active, the prompt `definition of spectral index` produced 3 references and explained how to estimate the error on this quantity. This information was missing in the answer without the skill.

![The definition of spectral index given with the skill loaded.](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8e140ce2-0b02-4683-95ac-071581a9e62d){width=676}
